sourceTitle: We’re partnering with Blue Origin on our first heavy-lift Project Suncatcher launch.
originalTitle: We’re partnering with Blue Origin on our first heavy-lift Project Suncatcher launch.
author: Travis Beals

blocks.text: We’re partnering with Blue Origin on the first heavy-lift launch for Project Suncatcher, our long-term moonshot to scale AI infrastructure in space by tapping into the abundant solar power in orbit.
blocks.zh: 我们正与 Blue Origin 合作开展 Project Suncatcher 的首次重型运载发射，这是我们的一项长期登月计划，旨在通过利用轨道上丰富的太阳能来扩展太空中的 AI 基础设施。
blocks.en: We’re partnering with Blue Origin on the first heavy-lift launch for Project Suncatcher, our long-term moonshot to scale AI infrastructure in space by tapping into the abundant solar power in orbit.

blocks.text: Targeted for Q1 2029, Blue Origin’s heavy-lift New Glenn rocket will deploy our satellites — each with roughly the capacity of a data center rack — into sun-synchronous orbit.
blocks.zh: 目标时间为 2029 年第一季度，Blue Origin 的重型运载火箭 New Glenn 将把我们的卫星——每颗容量大致相当于一个数据中心机架——部署到太阳同步轨道。
blocks.en: Targeted for Q1 2029, Blue Origin’s heavy-lift New Glenn rocket will deploy our satellites — each with roughly the capacity of a data center rack — into sun-synchronous orbit.

blocks.text: This dedicated launch builds on our ongoing work with other satellite and launch partners and represents a crucial milestone on our long-term roadmap as we expand the boundaries of what's possible for the future of compute.
blocks.zh: 此次专用发射建立在我们与其他卫星和发射合作伙伴持续开展的工作基础之上，标志着我们长期路线图上的一个关键里程碑，我们将拓展计算未来的可能性边界。
